newsitem.title: USA: Sony names Lemberger head of Columbia-TriStar.
newsitem.headline: Sony names Lemberger head of Columbia-TriStar.

text.p: Sony Corp on Wednesday named Kenneth Lemberger to the post of president of its Columbia TriStar Motion Picture Group.

In a statement, Sony Pictures Entertainment said the move was part of the company's new organizational structure under John Calley, the president and chief operating officer of Sony Pictures Entertainment.

In his new role, Lemberger will be responsible for the worldwide business, financial and administrative activities of Sony Pictures Entertainment's film companies. He will also oversee Sony's new Digital Studio Division.
Lemberger replaces Fred Bernstein, who left last November.

In other moves, Sony said Bob Levin, currently president of worldwide marketing for the motion picture group will take on added responsibilties as marketing chief for all of Sony Pictures Entertainment's products.
